class Separate {
  static [key: string]: number;
  [key: string]: string;
  static one = 1;
  one = "instance";
}
const fixed: number = Separate["one"];
const own: string = new Separate()["one"];
class Parent { static inherited = 2; }
class Child extends Parent { static [key: string]: number; static own = 3; }
class ParentIndex { static [key: string]: number; }
class OwnIndex extends ParentIndex { static [key: number]: string; static 0 = "zero"; }
class ReadonlyIndex { static readonly [key: string]: number; static one = 4; }
console.log(fixed, own, Child.inherited, Child.own, OwnIndex[0], ReadonlyIndex.one);

class Duplicate { static [key: string]: number; static [other: string]: number; }
